title: Children's Pirate Adventure Cruise in Murrells Inlet
requirements: Infants and small children can ride in a pram or stroller
Suitable for all physical fitness levels
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb: Set sail on the Sea Gypsy for an unforgettable Children's Pirate Adventure in Murrells Inlet. Kids will be transformed into fearless pirates, complete with face paint and treasure hunting vests. As they embark on this swashbuckling journey, they’ll follow a treasure map, battle the notorious Pirate Pete with water cannons, and work together to uncover hidden treasures. This fun-filled 90-minute experience is designed for children ages 2-10, ensuring a memorable day on the water for the whole family.
